models.name: economic_discussion_board_users
models.description: User accounts for the economic discussion board platform. Stores authentication credentials and basic profile information for registered users. Each user can create posts, comments, and manage their own content. User accounts are required for all interactive features of the platform.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the user's password for authentication purposes. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Display name chosen by the user for public identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_user_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for users on the economic discussion board. Tracks active user sessions with connection details and temporal information. Each session is associated with a specific user account and provides audit trail for user activities.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user account that owns this session. {@link economic_discussion_board_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session initiation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated. Null if session is active.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_posts
models.description:
Primary entity for user-generated content in the economic discussion board.

Represents the core content creation feature where users can share their thoughts, insights, and questions about economic and political topics. Each post belongs to a specific channel and section, and is created by an authenticated user through their active session.

Posts can be edited or deleted by their authors, and can accumulate comments and attachments. The content includes title and body fields for structured information presentation.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where the post is published. {@link economic_discussion_board_channels.id}.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_section_id
foreignFields.description: Section within the channel where the post is categorized. {@link economic_discussion_board_sections.id}.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who created the post. {@link economic_discussion_board_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session during which the post was created. {@link economic_discussion_board_user_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the post summarizing its content.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content of the post containing detailed information.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economic_discussion_board_post_snapshots
models.description:
Historical record of post states for audit trail and content change tracking.

Captures point-in-time states of economic_discussion_board_posts to maintain a complete history of all modifications. Each snapshot records the complete state of a post at a specific moment, including all content fields and metadata.

Snapshots are created whenever a post is created, updated, or deleted, providing a complete audit trail of all changes. The snapshot data includes all fields from the original post to ensure historical accuracy.

This table supports content moderation by allowing administrators to review the complete history of a post's evolution.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Post that this snapshot records. {@link economic_discussion_board_posts.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the post at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content of the post at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated (from original post).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was deleted (from original post).

models.name: economic_discussion_board_comments
models.description:
User comments on economic discussion board posts.

Stores user comments with content, timestamps, and relationships to posts and users.
Each comment is associated with a specific post and created by an authenticated user.
Comments support soft deletion for content moderation while maintaining audit trails.
The comment content includes body text and timestamps for creation and modification.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment content text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Comment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Comment modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Comment deletion timestamp for soft delete.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_comment_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of economic discussion board comments.

Stores point-in-time states of comments for audit trails and change tracking.
Each snapshot captures the complete state of a comment at a specific moment in time.
Snapshots are created whenever a comment is modified and are never updated or deleted.
The snapshot includes all comment fields at the time of creation for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment content text at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Comment modification timestamp at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Comment deletion timestamp at snapshot time.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Attachment files uploaded by users to support posts and comments.

Stores metadata about uploaded files including file type, size, and storage location.
Each attachment is associated with a specific post or comment and created by an authenticated user.
Attachments remain attached to their parent entity even if the parent is modified or deleted.
The system supports multiple attachments per post or comment.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Post that this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_discussion_board_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment that this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_discussion_board_comments.id}.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Storage path of the file in the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economic_discussion_board_attachment_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of attachment metadata.

Captures point-in-time states of attachments for audit trails and change tracking.
Each snapshot records the attachment metadata at a specific point in time.
Snapshots are created whenever an attachment is modified or when significant changes occur.
The system maintains a complete history of attachment changes for compliance and auditing purposes.

Snapshots are immutable and cannot be modified after creation.

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Storage path of the file in the system at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
